title: Configuration generation record
description: What a service records for every configuration generation it publishes (DD-09 §4/§5): its identity, the generation number in this process, the digest of the merged non-secret inputs, the revision of the secrets (a digest, never a value), the Apollo release it consumed, and the digests of the immutable profiles it carries. Tasks freeze the profile digests they need; logs, metrics and the delivery record carry this shape and never a secret. schemaVersion is 1.
